notes.title: Klei Entertainment announced Away Team, a new Oxygen Not Included adventure
notes.content:
Klei Entertainment have revealed Away Team, a new adventure set in the world of the popular base-builder Oxygen Not Included but it's a little different.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2025/06/klei-entertainment-announced-away-team-a-new-oxygen-not-included-adventure/

notes.title: Blow up strange new worlds in Away Team, a Spelunky-style base builder from the Oxygen Not Included devs
notes.content:
Invisible Inc and Don't Starve developers Klei Interactive have announced Away Team, a 2D base-building game from the same universe as Oxygen Not Included. I have yet to play Oxygen Not Included, but Klei seldom miss - their Mark Of The Ninja remains one of my favouritest ninja shankfests - and Away Team already seems very appealing for putting a deeply inhumane emphasis on traitorous physics. Here be trailer.

Read more

notes.title: Klei's next game will make a side-scrolling survival crafter out of Oxygen Not Included's detailed fluid and heat physics
notes.content: The world of Oxygen Not Included is getting a little bigger, with developer Klei announcing Away Team, a side-scrolling survival crafting platformer and exploration game starring an adorable little Duplicant who gets separated from the rest of their colony... Read more.
